components.name: Dashboard Primary Button
components.description: Primary high-contrast button for dashboard form submissions and action triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #18181b; color: #fafafa; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; display: inline-flex; items-center; justify-content: center; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #27272a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #09090b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dashboard Outline Button
components.description: Secondary outline button for filters, exports, and secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #ffffff; color: #09090b; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #cbcbd2; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #f4f4f5; }

components.name: Public Apply CTA Button
components.description: Luminous solid ivory hero pill button on public collegiate pages.
components.css: .ds-btn-public-apply { background: #f7f5ee; color: #07160d; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(247,245,238,0.12); transition: all 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-public-apply:hover { background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 6px 28px rgba(247,245,238,0.22); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Public Glass Action Button
components.description: Architectural frosted glass pill button linking to portal authentication.
components.css: .ds-btn-public-glass { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: #ded9ce; font-family: Montserrat, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-public-glass:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); color: #f7f5ee; }

narrative.northStar: The Collegiate Sanctuary & The Flight Deck
narrative.overview: Scofist intentionally operates on a dual-world aesthetic architecture: The Public Surface ('The Collegiate Sanctuary') honors academic heritage, scholarly dignity, and moral purpose with deep obsidian grounds, warm ivory typography, and Playfair Display serif headlines; while The Dashboard Surface ('The Flight Deck') provides administrators, teachers, and event judges with a high-density, mission-critical operational cockpit featuring flat-by-default surfaces, HSL semantic variables, 8px precision corners, and multi-script support.
keyCharacteristics: Strict surface boundary division: Public pages never use dashboard data cards; dashboard screens never bleed marketing gradients or serif display fonts.
Atmospheric public grounding: Radial dark-emerald glows, muted sand and ivory text, architectural frosted glass headers.
Flight-deck data density: 14px base font scaling down to 10px (xxs) for status badges, tight 8px padding, sticky headers, and responsive role-based bottom bars.
Script-aware academic inclusivity: Purpose-built font stacks handling Arabic treatises and Malayalam texts alongside English Latin glyphs.

rules.name: The Surface Separation Rule
rules.body: Never use #080c09 obsidian or #f7f5ee ivory inside the dashboard. Conversely, never use dashboard zinc grey tables or raw HSL cards on the public homepage.

rules.name: The Functional Color Rule
rules.body: In the dashboard, color indicates state only (present/absent, paid/unpaid, active/locked). Never introduce saturated accent colors for decoration.

rules.name: The Serif Containment Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display is exclusively permitted on public editorial landing surfaces and graduation/merit certificates. It must never appear inside dashboard tables, forms, or sidebars.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Dashboard surfaces are flat at rest. Depth is communicated through 1px border contrast, not floating drop shadows.

dos: Do respect the surface boundary: use Playfair Display, #080c09, and pill geometry on public pages; use Montserrat/Google Sans, HSL tokens, and 8px precision corners in the dashboard.
Do apply .book-text-font whenever rendering book titles, Arabic citations, or Malayalam student records.
Do keep dashboard tables compact: use text-xs or text-sm, bounded row heights, and sticky column headers.
Do ensure all dashboard interactive components support both Light and Dark themes via Tailwind dark: variants.
Do provide immediate keyboard focus rings (focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring) on all dashboard action triggers.
donts: Don't add drop shadows or gradients to dashboard data tables or management forms.
Don't use decorative uppercase pills or marketing tags inside administrative data grids.
Don't place public marketing slogans, testimonials, or pricing tables inside the dashboard.
Don't invent random hex colors; always use HSL semantic tokens (border-border, bg-card, text-muted-foreground) in dashboard views.
Don't hardcode light-only colors (bg-white, text-black) inside dashboard components without their dark mode counterparts.
